mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to construct a state where a clinician creates a note without being on the care team, or a patient reads another patient's record, or a compliance officer reads clinical content. This is exactly what LeastPrivilege and PermissionGrounding are meant to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some disj u: User, r: Record, cn: ClinicalNote | u.role = Clinician and cn.author = u and cn.record = r and no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = u and m.record = r and m.is_active = true }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits a clinical note to exist without a corresponding audit entry, violating the required one-to-one mapping between note creation and audit events.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some cn: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.record = cn.record and ae.accessor = cn.author and ae.operation = OpAppend and ae.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows duplicate note IDs or audit entries to exist, which violates the immutable append-only invariant that requires every note and entry to be uniquely identifiable.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj cn1, cn2: ClinicalNote | cn1.note_id = cn2.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries or clinical notes to exist without an accessor or author, which violates the requirement that all operations be performed by authenticated users.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | no ae.accessor }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a patient to access (read/write) a record they do not own, violating the ownership-based access control that restricts patients to their own assigned record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some ae: AuditEntry, u: User | u.role = Patient and ae.accessor = u and ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.record.id != u.assigned_record_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a clinician author to create a clinical note without active care-team membership, violating the requirement that clinicians must be active members of the care team for a record before they can write notes to it.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamViolation { some u: User, r: Record, cn: ClinicalNote | u.role = Clinician and cn.author = u and cn.record = r and no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = u and m.record = r and m.is_active = true }
